network.tag_allocation: physical request register fill; preedge free tags
network.tag_release: physical port acceptance from responseFIFO2 into returnFIFO4; no sameedge reuse
network.topology: sole fallback: separate three-stage radix4 request/return with 64 endpoints, 48 legal front destinations; local CAN/SCR/admin bypass global network
network.admin_merge: RR2 of front request stage2 class1 hold and local admin FIFO4, additional output hold
network.stage0_front_FIFO: the existing sourceFIFO4 is radix stage0 input; no duplicate FIFO
network.local_return: one registered source holding demux; full payload/status for reads

front_context.type: elastic oneentry registered; replacement allowed on old downstreamhandshake

front_leaf.token_release: both branch handshakes recorded, one retirement/group/cycle, nextedge reuse
front_leaf.E_slot_release: immutable operand capture; no sameedge reuse
front_leaf.EDGE_request_arbitration: laneRR, lowesteligiblecontext/lane; pointer advances on heldrequestcapture

directory.publication_waits: actual append response, then deferred upstream ACK
directory.global_min_collector: actual services::MinimumCollector; start C commands C+1; last response R tree capture R+1 consume R+7

backend.local_to_global_boundary: global network replaces frozen local port at logical CAN/SCR clients; no second port cascade; local fourclient cycle evidence not transferred wholesale

output.group_input_contexts: reuse front target_context; no duplicated register
output.same_cell_forwarding: s1 newest then last actual RAM write

causal_counters.fixed_observer: lane0 in expand, bank0 in finalize; exclusive priority labels documented in model README; not sum bank retries
causal_counters.critical_tail: for each wave choose bank whose actual last-busy/drain cycle is latest, retain its exclusive histogram; diagnostic not a counterfactual proof
causal_counters.emit_population: number of actual lane operand captures each observed cycle, histogram0..64
causal_counters.occupancy: pergroup fork,H/D,M,ready,E,beat histograms at all step edges; initialized/export direct loops separately charged
causal_counters.waves: actual group requests/returns and perkind/physicalport issue deltas per wave

frontend_decoupled.T_release: actual copy to D; next edge reuse
frontend_decoupled.D_release: both immutable branch copies complete; next edge reuse
frontend_decoupled.zero_degree: no ready slot, graph branch completes at held selection edge
frontend_decoupled.target_fifo: one preedge-full FIFO8; output target context remains distinct

publication_pipeline.issue: FIFO record order; one event/cycle command arbitration, real directory II2
publication_pipeline.ACK: strict ordered mapping FIFO32; actual RAM completion
publication_pipeline.retire: FIFO head after all actual ACK and POP immutable token handoff; no sameedge reuse
publication_pipeline.directory: reserve member + response before acceptance, 4 pipeline registers, responseFIFO8, ACK earliest accept+5; all control commands after full drain
publication_pipeline.completion_context: actual df_ack_slice: capture C, external completion/POP handoff earliest C+1, deferred core retire ACK earliest C+2; lock reusable C+3
publication_pipeline.control_context: command FIFO2 and response FIFO2 with actual one-cycle minimum each; MIN/TAKE/RELEASE after append/journal drain
